\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 221-224 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:UR-R229-first-pass-words-from-chapters-221-224}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a petrol station and a seat.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item annoyed, surprised, shy, quiet, splendid
  \item tasty, useless, unusual, fake, truthful
  \item cunning, decent, rude, polite, beautiful
  \item an iron, a broom, a jug, a dinner plate, a small bowl
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Annoyed? (\textbf{\ur{ناراض}}, \emph{nārāz}.) Surprised? (\textbf{\ur{حیران}}, \emph{hairān}.) Shy? (\textbf{\ur{شرمیلا}}, \emph{sharmīlā}.) Quiet? (\textbf{\ur{خاموش}}, \emph{khāmosh}.) Splendid? (\textbf{\ur{شاندار}}, \emph{shāndār}.) Tasty? (\textbf{\ur{مزیدار}}, \emph{mazedār}.) Useless? (\textbf{\ur{بیکار}}, \emph{bekār}.) Unusual? (\textbf{\ur{انوکھا}}, \emph{anokhā}.) Fake? (\textbf{\ur{نقلی}}, \emph{naqlī}.) Truthful? (\textbf{\ur{سچا}}, \emph{sachchā}.) Cunning? (\textbf{\ur{چالاک}}, \emph{chālāk}.) Decent? (\textbf{\ur{شریف}}, \emph{sharīf}.) Rude? (\textbf{\ur{بدتمیز}}, \emph{badtamīz}.) Polite? (\textbf{\ur{تمیزدار}}, \emph{tamīzdār}.) Beautiful? (\textbf{\ur{حسین}}, \emph{hasīn}.) An iron? (\textbf{\ur{استری}}, \emph{istrī}.) A broom? (\textbf{\ur{جھاڑو}}, \emph{jhāṛū}.) A jug? (\textbf{\ur{جگ}}, \emph{jag}.) A dinner plate? (\textbf{\ur{پلیٹ}}, \emph{pleṭ}.) A small bowl? (\textbf{\ur{کٹوری}}, \emph{kaṭorī}.)
\end{tcolorbox}

A file? (\textbf{\ur{فائل}}, \emph{fāil}.) Coriander? (\textbf{\ur{دھنیا}}, \emph{dhaniyā}.) Mint? (\textbf{\ur{پودینہ}}, \emph{pudīnā}.) An aubergine? (\textbf{\ur{بینگن}}, \emph{baiṅgan}.) A pumpkin? (\textbf{\ur{کدو}}, \emph{kaddū}.) Spinach? (\textbf{\ur{پالک}}, \emph{pālak}.) An animal? (\textbf{\ur{جانور}}, \emph{jānvar}.) A buffalo? (\textbf{\ur{بھینس}}, \emph{bhaiṅs}.) A leopard? (\textbf{\ur{ٹیم}}, \emph{ṭīm}.) A player? (\textbf{\ur{کھلاڑی}}, \emph{khilāṛī}.) A film? (\textbf{\ur{فلم}}, \emph{film}.) A play? (\textbf{\ur{ناٹک}}, \emph{nāṭak}.) A motorbike? (\textbf{\ur{موٹر} \ur{سائیکل}}, \emph{moṭar sāikil}.) A lorry? (\textbf{\ur{ٹرک}}, \emph{ṭrak}.) Petrol? (\textbf{\ur{پیٹرول}}, \emph{peṭrol}.) A petrol station?
